Trigger A creature ends a move action within 10 ft of Lich Faltyr.

Effect Lich Faltyr sends a mental blast in a wave that assaults all enemies in the area. Each enemy in a @Template[type:emanation|distance:30]{30-foot} emanation must succeed at a @Check[type:will|dc:30|name:Synapse Overload] save and suffer the following effects.


Critical Success The creature is unaffected.
Success The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} 1.
Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} 2.
Critical Failure The creature is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.dfCMdR4wnpbYNTix]{Stunned 1} for 1 round.
